artists.biography: A supergroup of sought after songwriters and musicians, former members of the legendary band Jellyfish. The musical journeys of Eric Dover, Roger Joseph Manning Jr. and Tim Smith have synchronized for the first time since 1994. Just like any great relationship, they simply picked up where they left off. Roger Joseph Manning Jr. (Beck, Air, Cheap Trick and Imperial Drag) Eric Dover (Imperial Drag, Slash's Snakepit, Alice Cooper, Sextus) Tim Smith (Noel Gallagher's High Flying Birds, The Finn Brothers, Sheryl Crow, Umajets) Website: https://thelickerishquartet.com/ Twitter: @thelickerish Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Threesome Vol. 1" is the debut EP by The Lickerish Quartet, released in 2020 under Label Logic and INgrooves. The album showcases a blend of rock with strong influences from classic 1970s AM pop and modern rock, characterized by melodic, catchy songwriting and a polished, airy production style. The EP features four tracks—"Fadoodle," "Bluebird’s Blues," "There Is a Magic Number," and "Lighthouse Spaceship"—that highlight the trio's ability to merge upbeat grooves with subtle sonic textures, maintaining a playful and tongue-in-cheek attitude throughout.

This release marks an important entry in the members’ discography, as it reunites musicians Roger Joseph Manning Jr., Tim Smith, and Eric Dover, all veterans of notable projects like Jellyfish and Slash’s Snakepit. "Threesome Vol. 1" received critical acclaim for its songwriting and musicianship, earning high praise such as a 98% rating from reviewers who noted the EP’s infectious melodies and cohesive sound. The single "Lighthouse Spaceship" gained significant attention, accumulating tens of thousands of plays on streaming platforms, underscoring the EP’s positive reception both critically and commercially.
